name: OdiChat
source:
OdiChat is an LGBTQ+ narrative based visual novel which takes place on a virtual platform. The game focuses on creating a cozy community where people can share their stories and connect with one another!

Get to know all the other group members and discuss topics like relationships and mental health in a safe and welcoming environment.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2474280/OdiChat/]Steam[/url]]
